title: Financial worker claims a document task, fills all 14 fields, saves draft, and submits
description: A financial expert (doc_worker) navigates to customs, claims a task from the pool, fills out all financial data, saves a draft, and submits it to the supervisor.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with admin
Fill in the password field with 123456
Submit the login form
Navigate to /customs
Click on the Pool tab (استخر)
Select the first available document task in the pool by checking its checkbox
Click the claim button (بر عهده گرفتن)
Click on the My Tasks tab (کارهای من)
Click on the newly claimed document task to open its details panel
Fill in the Added RTI No field with RTI-9988
Fill in the Invoice RTI field with INV-RTI-001
Select the first option from the Invoice Type dropdown
Fill in the Invoice Date field with 2026-08-01
Fill in the Invoice Page field with 5
Fill in the Page Row field with 12
Fill in the Supplier field with Tech Corp
Fill in the Total Value field with 15000
Fill in the Price Amount field with 14500
Fill in the Similar Unit Price field with 14600
Select the first option from the Currency dropdown
Fill in the Folder Address field with /docs/2026/08
Check the Stamp checkbox (مهر)
Check the Signature checkbox (امضا)
Fill in the Worker Note textarea with All values checked and verified
Click the Save Draft button (ذخیره پیش‌نویس)
Verify a success toast message appears
Click on the task in My Tasks list to open it again
Click the Submit button (ارسال)
Verify a success message appears after submission

title: Supervisor rejects a processed financial document
description: The supervisor reviews a DOC_PROCESSED document and rejects it back to the worker.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with admin
Fill in the password field with 123456
Submit the login form
Navigate to /supervisor-dashboard
Click on the Financial/Documents tab (مالی/اسناد)
Verify at least one document task card is visible in the list
Check the checkbox of the first document task card
Click the Reject button (رد)
Enter Missing valid signature in the rejection note textarea
Click the confirm reject button (ثبت رد)
Verify a success toast message appears

title: Supervisor approves a processed financial document and sends to manager
description: The supervisor reviews a DOC_PROCESSED document and approves it, sending it to the manager.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with admin
Fill in the password field with 123456
Submit the login form
Navigate to /supervisor-dashboard
Click on the Financial/Documents tab (مالی/اسناد)
Verify at least one document task card is visible
Check the checkbox of the first document task card
Click the Send to Manager button (ارسال به مدیر)
Enter Looks good in the approval note textarea
Click the confirm send button (ارسال به مدیر)
Verify a success toast message appears

title: Manager gives final approval to the financial document
description: The manager views the DOC_MANAGER_REVIEW document in manager-review and gives final approval.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with admin
Fill in the password field with 123456
Submit the login form
Navigate to /manager-review
Scroll down to the Financial Documents Review section (بررسی نهایی اسناد مالی)
Verify at least one financial document card is visible
Check the checkbox of the first financial document card
Click the Final Approve button (تایید نهایی)
Enter final approval in the manager note textarea
Click the confirm final approve button (تایید نهایی)
Verify a success toast message appears
